title: Coder reliability + rubric calibration
description: Code the same material blind across three coders, then let a teacher model critique the coders against the codebook until reliability is demonstrated rather than asserted.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-soc-01
  title: Coder reliability + rubric calibration
  description: Code the same material blind across three coders, then let a teacher model critique the
    coders against the codebook until reliability is demonstrated rather than asserted.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce coded qualitative data with inter-coder reliability established and codebook ambiguities
    repaired before any finding is drawn from the codes.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Transcripts and codebook
      summary: Transcripts and codebook
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - transcripts
              - codebook
              - coding_unit
              - agreement_threshold
            properties:
              transcripts: {}
              codebook: {}
              coding_unit: {}
              agreement_threshold: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-assess1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: soc-02
      name: First blind coding pass
      summary: Blind assessment 1; no sight of the other assessments.
      role: Qualitative analyst applying a codebook consistently and transparently.
      prompt: You are a Qualitative Coding Analyst. You apply the codebook to text with the excerpt behind
        every code assignment, and you record codes that were ambiguous rather than forcing them into
        the nearest category. You code independently of other coders when the design calls for it, because
        reconciled-in-the-moment coding cannot produce a meaningful reliability statistic.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - implementation
          - evidence-verification
          - design-review
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-assess2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: soc-02
      name: Second blind coding pass
      summary: Blind assessment 2; no sight of the other assessments.
      role: Qualitative analyst applying a codebook consistently and transparently.
      prompt: You are a Qualitative Coding Analyst. You apply the codebook to text with the excerpt behind
        every code assignment, and you record codes that were ambiguous rather than forcing them into
        the nearest category. You code independently of other coders when the design calls for it, because
        reconciled-in-the-moment coding cannot produce a meaningful reliability statistic.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - implementation
          - evidence-verification
          - design-review
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-assess3
      kind: agent
      templateRef: soc-01
      name: Methodological review of the coding frame
      summary: Blind assessment 3; no sight of the other assessments.
      role: Methodologist designing instruments and samples that measure what they claim to.
      prompt: You are a Survey Methodologist. You design instruments with tested question wording, response
        options that do not force a position, and a sampling plan whose frame and expected non-response
        are stated. You name the population a sample can actually support inference about, because the
        gap between the sampled frame and the population of interest is where most survey claims fail.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - design-review
          - evaluation
          - decision-analysis
          - teaching
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-panel
      kind: group
      name: Blind coding panel
      summary: Every assessor runs on the same evidence in parallel; the group exits only once all member
        results are aggregated.
      config:
        members:
          - n-assess1
          - n-assess2
          - n-assess3
        execution: parallel
        exit: aggregate
    - id: n-teacher
      kind: teacher
      inlineRole: true
      name: Rubric calibration
      summary: Critique the assessors against the rubric — this scores the graders, not the work.
      role: Host-resolved teacher model
      prompt: 'You are the calibration teacher for this coding panel. Critique the coders against the
        codebook: which codes were applied inconsistently, which excerpts were coded without supporting
        text, and which code definitions are themselves ambiguous enough to guarantee disagreement? Return
        coder-level feedback and proposed codebook wording changes.'
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
      config:
        teacherModel: host:teacher-model
        feedbackMode: rubric
    - id: n-agreement
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Score inter-assessor agreement
      summary: Evaluate inter-coder agreement per code and excerpt evidence behind each assignment.
      role: Deterministic metric evaluator
      prompt: Evaluate the upstream result against inter-coder agreement per code and excerpt evidence
        behind each assignment. Return a score, pass/fail verdict, the evidence behind the verdict, remaining
        uncertainty, and the smallest corrective action. Do not claim programmatic measurement unless
        the host supplies the required tool.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - score
          - passed
          - reasons
        properties:
          score:
            type: number
          passed:
            type: boolean
          reasons:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
      config:
        threshold: 0.85
    - id: n-calibrated
      kind: condition
      name: Calibrated?
      summary: Route on agreement.passed.
      config:
        expression: agreement.passed
        branches:
          - label: Calibrated
            when: 'true'
          - label: Not calibrated
            when: 'false'
    - id: n-recalibrate
      kind: loop
      name: Recalibrate until assessors agree
      summary: Repeat a bounded revision sequence until inter-assessor agreement meets the declared threshold.
      config:
        body:
          - n-panel
          - n-teacher
          - n-agreement
          - n-calibrated
        exitCondition: inter-assessor agreement meets the declared threshold
        maxIterations: 3
        onExhausted: stop
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Principal investigator accepts the calibrated coding
      summary: Pause for the principal investigator; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Coder reliability + rubric calibration deliverable, the evidence behind
        it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-soc-01-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-panel
      kind: data
    - id: wf-soc-01-edge-2
      from: n-panel
      to: n-teacher
      kind: data
    - id: wf-soc-01-edge-3
      from: n-teacher
      to: n-agreement
      kind: data
    - id: wf-soc-01-edge-4
      from: n-agreement
      to: n-calibrated
      kind: data
    - id: wf-soc-01-edge-5
      from: n-calibrated
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: 'true'
    - id: wf-soc-01-edge-6
      from: n-calibrated
      to: n-recalibrate
      kind: control
      condition: 'false'
    - id: wf-soc-01-edge-7
      from: n-recalibrate
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exit
    - id: wf-soc-01-edge-8
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
